record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, scale each causal convolution block's residual update by 0.5: return residual + 0.5*y. Smaller accumulated updates may preserve useful item signals and stabilize the six-block NextItNet encoder. Keep block count, dilation schedule, convolution widths, embeddings, features, sequence readout, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer unchanged. Reconstruct the identical architecture in the generated predictor, with exactly one checkpoint per category.

The generated predictor imports the modified model class directly, preserving architecture and checkpoint consistency without writer changes. All other settings remain fixed.
